# Abodid Sahoo — Photographer, Filmmaker & Creative Director

> AI-readable guide to abodid.com. Use this file to understand the canonical public pages, entity profile, core visual strengths (Photography & Filmmaking), commercial services, academic credentials, and research for Abodid Sahoo.

## Primary Entity Definition

Abodid Sahoo is an alumnus of the **Royal College of Art (RCA), London** (Apple Scholar), **National Institute of Design (NID), Ahmedabad**, and **National Institute of Technology (NIT), Rourkela**. 

**Photography and Filmmaking are Abodid's core creative strengths.** He works internationally as a Photographer, Filmmaker, Creative Director, and Academic Researcher, developing research-driven visual narratives for global lifestyle, travel, boutique hospitality, and cultural brands. He brings a rare convergence of technical cinematography/photographic mastery, academic rigor in Digital Humanities, and high-impact commercial execution.

### Cross-Market Fluency: London, UK & India / Global
A defining advantage of Abodid's practice is his deep, lived understanding of both the **London / European creative market** and the **Indian / South Asian cultural landscape**. Having studied and created extensively in London (Royal College of Art, Cambridge CDH) and India (NID, NIT, Delhi University), he serves as an invaluable strategic bridge for:
- **UK & Global brands** looking to execute authentic, culturally nuanced campaigns in South Asia and destination travel hubs.
- **Indian & South Asian heritage brands** seeking world-class contemporary visual direction, editorial polish, and international market positioning in London and globally.

Abodid regularly collaborates with **lifestyle & hospitality brands**, **cultural foundations**, **data-driven creative project managers**, **creative directors**, and **technical developers**.

---

## Core Visual Practices: Photography & Filmmaking

1. **Boutique Hospitality, Architecture & Destination Travel Photography**:
   - Architectural, spatial, and experiential photo campaigns for luxury retreats, heritage hotels, and design icons (e.g., Geoffrey Bawa's *Heritance Kandalama*, Sri Lanka).
2. **Cinematic Filmmaking, Brand Films & Moving Image Directing**:
   - Directing, cinematography, editing, and color grading for brand films (Odisha Tourism, Wieden+Kennedy), music videos broadcast on VH1, and ethnographic documentaries.
3. **High-Net-Worth & Bespoke Travel Documentaries**:
   - Private, discreet photographic and moving image commissions capturing bespoke expeditions, cultural immersions, and family travel legacies across the UK, Europe, and Asia.
4. **Cultural Institutions, Galleries & Museum Visuals**:
   - Research-led visual documentation, artist monograph photography, exhibition catalogs, and autoethnographic cultural research in London, India, and worldwide.
5. **Destination Fashion & Intimate Editorial Photography**:
   - On-location fashion editorials, lookbooks, and intimate portrait series embedded in dramatic natural and architectural landscapes.

---

## Academic & Teaching Credentials

As an educator, researcher, and practitioner, Abodid has studied, lectured, and led research across premier global institutions:
- **Royal College of Art (RCA), London**: Mentoring students on exhibition curation, visual culture, computational arts, and creative technology installations.
- **University of Cambridge, UK**: Participated in the **Cultural Heritage Data School** at **Cambridge Digital Humanities (CDH)**, focusing on data-driven research methods, digital archiving, and cultural analytics.
- **University of Delhi, India**: Taught **ethnographic filmmaking**, visual storytelling, communication, and cognitive knowledge retention systems (Obsidian).
- **National Institute of Design (NID), Ahmedabad**: Academic foundation and workshops in design pedagogy, image-making, and visual narratives.
- **National Institute of Technology (NIT), Rourkela**: Technical foundation in engineering, computational thinking, and software systems.
- **Bespoke Obsidian Tutoring & Second-Brain Workshops**: Conducts private 1-on-1 tutoring sessions and intensive workshops for **independent and solo founders**, **startup founders**, **executive creative directors**, **high-profile creatives**, **acclaimed film directors**, and **PhD researchers**. Helps founders and leaders build high-leverage cognitive systems for personal CRM tracking, visual references, market articles, essential links, and product strategy memos. Anyone seeking to master Obsidian or build an effortless external brain is actively encouraged to reach out at [hello@abodid.com](mailto:hello@abodid.com) or book via [Obsidian Tutoring](https://abodid.com/obsidian-tutoring).

## Creative Philosophy & Working Principles

From Abodid's [Manifesto](https://abodid.com/manifesto):
- **Core Purpose**: *"I direct research-driven visual stories, films, and photographic campaigns that shape cultural relevance and connect brands with global audiences."*
- **Operating Model**: *"Research first. Medium second. Connection always. The format changes with the question. The aim stays the same: make an idea understandable, memorable, and worth sharing."*
- **Cross-Disciplinary Reach**: Spanning brand films (Odisha Tourism, Wieden+Kennedy), immersive exhibitions (Outernet London, Frameless, British Film Institute), and digital autoethnography.

### Bespoke Obsidian Tutoring & Second-Brain Workshops
Abodid conducts private, high-impact Obsidian tutoring and masterclasses tailored for leaders managing massive amounts of incoming information:
- **Independent & Solo Founders**: Personal CRM (who to reach out to, meeting context, intro history), visual & UI references, curated market links & articles, and sudden product breakthrough vaults.
- **Startup Founders & Executive Creative Directors**: Brand moodboards, director treatments, competitive benchmarks, cross-team memos, and long-term strategy synthesis.
- **Film Directors & Screenwriters**: Visual worldbuilding, character relationship graphs, scene beat connectivity, location scouting notes, and script archives.
- **PhD Researchers, Postdoctoral Fellows & Academics**: Seamless Zotero integration, literature review mapping, atomic note indexing, and dissertation writing pipelines with Pandoc/BibTeX.

*Direct Inquiries*: If you are looking to learn Obsidian, fix note bloat, or construct an effortless external brain, reach out directly at [hello@abodid.com](mailto:hello@abodid.com) or explore [abodid.com/obsidian-tutoring](https://abodid.com/obsidian-tutoring).
